706973.name: Backtrack
706973.desc: Marks an enemy's location, yanking them back to the location after 2.5 sec.

707409.name: Time Locked
707409.desc: Increases the duration of Chronostasis by 4 sec.

707551.name: Wand Master
707551.desc: Increases the damage of Wand of Time and Artificer's Wand by 10%.

707553.name: Distorted Time
707553.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Timerend by -2 sec and increases the duration of Decomposition by 3 sec.

707556.name: Warpstriker
707556.desc: Reduces the cost of your spells by -5% and the chance for your spells to be dispelled by 10%.

707656.name: Maker of Realities
707656.desc: Casting Hasten now also always reduces the cast time of your healing spells by an additional -20%.

712416.name: Dark Bomb
712416.desc: Damage dealt by Unmake now slows the target's movement speed by 5% for 0, stacking 20 times.

800053.name: Fray Magic
800053.desc: Interrupts an enemy's spell cast, preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 4 sec. While active, the enemy's spells and abilities have 0% increased resource costs.

800669.name: Do Over
800669.desc: Restores a dead ally to life with 70 health and 135 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

800856.name: Decomposition
800856.desc: Distortion Spell Decompose an enemy, dealing 0 Chromatic Damage over 21 sec. This damage is dealt slowly, and accelerates as it reaches the full duration. Damage increased by 25% for each Echo Fragment consumed. Haste does not decrease the duration but increases the total instances of damage.

800857.name: Accelerated Recovery
800857.desc: Accelerates the bodies natural healing process, healing the target for 65 + 115% healing over 15 seconds.

801110.name: Temporal Duel
801110.desc: Transport yourself and an enemy into another timeline for 15 sec. While active, your damage taken is reduced by 15%.

801267.name: Chronobeam
801267.desc: Rapidly age an enemy target over 2 sec, dealing 241.08 Chaos Damage every 0.5 sec.

801270.name: Epoch
801270.desc: Mend an ally with magic bestowed upon you by the Bronze Dragonflight, healing them for 219.72 and granting you Sands of Time.

801271.name: Continuum Restoration
801271.desc: Restore the continuum at target location for all allies and enemies within 15 yds, removing all beneficial magic effects from enemies and harmful magic effects from allies. This dispel is potent enough to remove magic effects that are normally undispellable

801278.name: Past Self
801278.desc: Creates a clone of an ally for 30 sec which will mimic their spells and abilities (except this spell) on a 2 sec delay. After being targeted by this spell, Past Self cannot be cast on the ally again for 30 sec. If you cast this spell on yourself, you cannot cast it again at all for another 30 sec.

801283.name: Mass Decomposition
801283.desc: Chronurgy spreads Decomposition to enemies within 8 yds.

801288.name: Chronicles of History
801288.desc: You begin magically documenting the actions of an ally for 7 sec. At the end of the duration, they will recast all spells abilities that they cast during the documentation period upon their current target.

801290.name: Discordant Blast
801290.desc: Hurl a mass of chaotic magic an enemy target for 57.8 to 60.8 Time Damage. Time Damage is a combination of Frost and Arcane. Grants 1 Chromatic. While Chromatic Incarnate is active, this ability deals 100% increased damage.

801291.name: Timerend
801291.desc: Rend the fabric of time, dealing 0 Chromatic Damage over 6 sec.

801292.name: Chromatic Shard
801292.desc: Fling a shard of chaos at an enemy, dealing 162 + 150% SP Chromatic Damage, piercing immunities and resistances. Dealing damage with Anomaly Spikes reduces the cast time of this ability by -5% for 30 seconds, stacking 10 times.

801293.name: Infinite Tome
801293.desc: Every time you cast a Chromatic or Order spell, you will gain a Chromatic Charge or Order Charge respectively. Upon reaching 4 charges of any kind, you will perform an additional effect based on the combination of charges. Order + Order + Order + Order = Add 3 stacks of Accelerated Recovery to party and raid members within 40 yards. Order + Order + Order + Chromatic = Gain Hasten, Spell Deflection, and Time Loop. Order + Order + Chromatic + Chromatic = Restore 30% of your maximum Mana and 20% of your Maximum Health. Then, Summon an Infinite Clone. Chromatic + Chromatic + Chromatic + Order = Launch 3 Epochs at your current target. Chromatic + Chromatic + Chromatic + Chromatic = Advance all stacks of Decomposition on nearby enemies by 3.

801294.name: Rewind
801294.desc: You rewind back to your last Infinite Clone, setting your health, mana, and position to what it was when the clone was created.

801295.name: Slow Time
801295.desc: Slows your targets movement speed by 20% and their attack speed by 20% for 6 sec. Grants 1 Order.

801296.name: Reflection
801296.desc: Place a barrier upon yourself, healing for 322.84 and causing them to reflect the next harmful spell within 2 sec.

801297.name: Time Loop
801297.desc: You place a Time Loop on an ally. The next spell or ability they use within 10 sec that has a cooldown of at least 8 seconds will incur no cooldown.

801298.name: Flashback
801298.desc: Instantly finishes an ally's current cooldowns. After being targeted by this spell, Flashback cannot be cast on the ally again for 2 min.

801303.name: Reverse Wound
801303.desc: Reverse an ally's wound, healing them for 325.782. Extends the duration of Accelerated Recovery by 2 sec.

801304.name: Hasten
801304.desc: Hasten time for an ally, increasing movement speed and haste by 20% and granting them a 0% chance when they deal damage to strike the target an additional time equal to 30% of the damage dealt. Lasts 12 sec. While active the cooldowns of Dimensional Divergence, Backtrack, and Timeguard are reduced by 10% every 2 sec.

801306.name: Fracture Timeline
801306.desc: Creates a clone of an enemy player for 8 sec which will deal 70% of all damage it takes to the original target.

801317.name: Passage of Time
801317.desc: Increases periodic damage taken from the Chronomancer by 2% for 10 sec, stacking 10 times.

801523.name: Chromie's Wisdom
801523.desc: Share Chromie's wisdom with an allied player, increasing their Spirit by 10. Lasts 30 min. Only one Wisdom per Chronomancer can be active.

802229.name: Time Out!
802229.desc: Enter a stasis for 6 sec, instantly restoring 15% of your maximum mana and regenerating 5% of your maximum mana every 0.001 sec. While active, your damage taken is reduced by 50% but any direct damage taken may end the effect.

802790.name: Dimensional Divergence
802790.desc: Swap places with a target. If they're an enemy, you steal -80% of their movement speed for 3 seconds.

803560.name: Spirit Communion
803560.desc: Commune the spirits with the target ally, healing them for 0 over 9 sec.

803706.name: Hasty Strike
803706.desc: Hasten time for an ally, increasing movement speed and haste by 2% and granting them a 25% chance when they deal damage to strike the target an additional time equal to 0% of the damage dealt. Lasts 0. While active the cooldowns of Dimensional Divergence, Backtrack, and Timeguard are reduced by 10% every 2 sec.

804363.name: Scimitar Strike
804363.desc: You strike the target with your weapon, dealing 1% Weapon Damage. If you have an off-hand weapon equipped, you will also deal 1% Offhand Weapon Damage. Each use of Scimitar Strike reduces the cooldown of subsequent Scimitar Strikes by 15% and increases their Critical Strike Chance by 10% for 10 sec, stacks up to 5 times.

804418.name: Unmake
804418.desc: Unmake an enemy, dealing 45611.4 Chromatic Damage over 1 sec.

804420.name: Artificer's Toughness
804420.desc: Gain Armor based on your Spirit for 0.

804422.name: Artificer's Magic
804422.desc: Gain spell power based on your Spirit for 0.

804423.name: Wand of Extinction
804423.desc: Decays an enemy, causing 0 Chromatic Damage over 1 sec.

804425.name: Chaos Wand
804425.desc: Your next Wand attack will deal 2 additional Chromatic damage.

804431.name: Artificer's Spellplate
804431.desc: Gain magic resistance based on your Spirit for 0.

804435.name: Flux Emitter
804435.desc: Continuum Spell Empower Wand attacks to affect up to 2 additional nearby enemies for 3 sec plus 5 sec per Echo Fragment. Affected attacks deal less damage per additional enemy hit. Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.

804436.name: Aether Compression
804436.desc: Continuum Spell Artificer's Wand and Reverse Wound can be cast while moving for 5 seconds. Duration increased by 5 sec per Echo Fragment.

804437.name: Singularity Core
804437.desc: Blasts the target for 2 Arcane damage.

804441.name: Timeguard
804441.desc: Place a magical guard on an ally for 2 minutes, causing the next 3 instances of direct damage that would reduce the target below 35% health to deal 40% less damage.

804444.name: Shield of the Ages
804444.desc: When hit by a damaging critical strike, your damage taken is reduced by -3%, and healing received is increased by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking 3 times.

804448.name: Collapse
804448.desc: Marks an enemy for 3 sec. At the end of the duration, they will be stunned for 4 sec. The target takes 50% increased periodic damage while stunned. Dare you to use this.

804450.name: Erase
804450.desc: Periodic damage taken from the Chronomancer's periodic effects increased by 0%.

804452.name: Conduction Burst
804452.desc: Your Shatter Echo now deals 20% additional damage while a Continuum spell is active.

804455.name: Echo Fragment
804455.desc: Used to empower some abilities. Stacks 5 times.

804470.name: Time Skip Trigger
804470.desc: Launch a blast of magical sand, dealing 100 Arcane Damage to up to 0 enemies within 0 yds of the target. This spell belongs to Order. The next time the primary target receives damage, allies within 10 yds are healed for 10% maximum health.

804483.name: Order Incarnate
804483.desc: Reduces the cast time of Order spells by 70% and their cooldowns by 50%. Also boosts healing done by 100%.

804484.name: Chaos Incarnate
804484.desc: Reduces the cast time of Chromatic spells by 60%, cooldowns by 50%, and increases damage by 20%.

804487.name: Echo
804487.desc: While at 4 stacks of Discovery, casting Unearth consumes these stacks to generate an Echo.

804489.name: Upheaval
804489.desc: Increases the duration of your next Chronobeam by 100%, stacking 3 times.

804491.name: Fortify Timeline
804491.desc: Fortify the current timeline, instantly healing all allies for 261 + 40% SP and extending the duration of Accelerated Recovery on them by 5.33 sec.

804493.name: Incarnation
804493.desc: Whenever you reach 20 stacks of either Order or Chromatic, you will now gain an Incarnate effect for 10 sec.

804495.name: Resynchronize
804495.desc: Switch to the timeline where your party didn't die, returning all party members to life with 583 health and 833 mana. Can be cast while dead, but cannot be used in combat.

804497.name: Flow of Infinity
804497.desc: Causes 20% of all Threat you generate to be redirected to your active permanent pet.

804498.name: Infinite Wrath
804498.desc: Causes 89.4 to 90.4 Chaos Damage to an enemy target, increasing with the caster's Spirit.

804501.name: Remake
804501.desc: Requires Balance or Order Majority Remakes an ally, Healing them for 42.4 to 43.4 every 0.5 for 1.5 sec. Grants 1 Order.

804502.name: Chronobeam Passive
804502.desc: The ticks of your periodic damaging and healing effects have a chance to boost the Quickness of your next Chronobeam spell by 20%, stacks up to 4 times.

804503.name: Shatter Echo
804503.desc: Distortion Spell Launch a distorted echo from your wand at an enemy, dealing 120% Ranged Weapon damage plus cond(gt(SPA, SPH), 4+2.45+SPA*0.3, 4+2.45+SPH*0.3) Arcane Damage. Damage increased by 40% for each Echo Fragment consumed.

804504.name: Fate Guard DEPRECATED
804504.desc: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 0.

804505.name: Timeline Tether
804505.desc: Your periodic damage and healing reduces the cooldown of your Fortify Timeline by -1 sec.

804516.name: Order Baseline Negative
804516.desc: Passively Negates the effect of 50% order

804517.name: Chaos Baseline Negative
804517.desc: Passively Negates the effect of 50% chaos

804753.name: Teleport: Caverns of Time
804753.desc: Teleports the caster to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

805162.name: Breath of Time
805162.desc: Breathe a blanket of sand over and enemy, dealing 394 Arcane Damage and incapacitating them for 3 sec. Taking any damage will break this effect.

805166.name: Rumble
805166.desc: Taunts all nearby enemies for 4 sec, and increases your threat against them by 35%.

805167.name: Chaos Embrace
805167.desc: Dispels a Magic Effect from an enemy and reduces their Magic Resistance by 15% for 8 sec.

805168.name: Infinite Shroud
805168.desc: Shroud your master, restoring 10% health and temporarily reducing all their threat for 6 sec.

805170.name: Timelink
805170.desc: Redirects 70% damage taken from the caster to the pet for 6 sec.

805843.name: Shield of Disintegration DEPRECATED
805843.desc: Pull enemies within 10 yds in front of you and reduce their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec, then channel for up to 6 sec, reducing all damage taken by 70%. When this ends, deal 588 Shadowfrost Damage based on how long you channeled for to nearby enemies.

805845.name: Timeline Guardian
805845.desc: Empowers Order spells for 16 sec, increasing the magnitude of their effects by 40% and generating 1 Order every 2 sec.

805846.name: Timeline Destroyer
805846.desc: Empowers Chromatic spells for 16 sec, increasing the magnitude of their effects by 40% and generating 1 Chromatic every 2 sec. In addition, you generate 1 stack of Chromatic every 2 sec for the duration.

805847.name: Clasp of Infinity
805847.desc: Conjure a magical binding upon an enemy that bounces to nearby enemies, rooting them in place for 4 seconds.

805848.name: Tome of Time
805848.desc: Generates 1 stack of Order or Chromatic every 0 sec for 0, whichever is higher.

805850.name: Blinding Sand
805850.desc: Sling pocket sand at enemies in the target area, causing them to wander disoriented for up to 0. Any damage caused will remove the effect. While blinded, enemies take 51% reduced healing. [Deprecated]

805851.name: Deconstruction
805851.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Unmake by 5%.

805854.name: Crown of Power
805854.desc: Increases the tick rate of Melt Reality by -25%.

806199.name: Disc of Legend (Deprecated)
806199.desc: Blasts an enemy for 241 Spellfrost Damage, reducing their movement speed by 20% for 3 sec, scaling with Spirit. Generates 1 Orb of Fate.

806203.name: Paradox Cannon
806203.desc: Continuum Spell Generate 1 Echo Fragment every 3 sec for 5 seconds, plus an additional 5 sec per Echo Fragment consumed. Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.

806206.name: Time Is A Circle
806206.desc: Level 40 Passive Casting Wand of Time now extends the duration of your Continuum spells by 3 sec. Continuum spells cannot be extended beyond their maximum duration.

806207.name: Last Wish
806207.desc: Increases the damage of your Pendant of Time and Gravity Bomb by 25% and causes them to grant you an Orb of Fate.

806208.name: Disenchant Weapon
806208.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Fray Magic by 5 sec and causes it to also Disarm the target for 6 sec.

806209.name: Threads of Eternity
806209.desc: Damage dealt by Discordance now applies Thread of Eternity to enemies.

806216.name: Wand Mastery
806216.desc: Wand of Time and Shatter Echo now have a 25% chance to unleash Crystal Cannon, launching 2 quick lesser Wand auto attacks at the enemy over 1 seconds, scaling with Spirit. While Paradox Cannon is active, the chance to trigger this effect is increased by 10%.

806244.name: Sandpage
806244.desc: Increases the damage of Sand Bomb by 15%.

806267.name: Ripple Aura
806267.desc: You radiate an aura for -0.001 sec, making party and raid members within 0 of you Immune to Silence and Interrupt effects. While active, affected allies are unaffected by the normal pushback from taking damage while casting.

806268.name: Fable
806268.desc: You radiate an aura for 12 sec, making party and raid members within 40 of you Immune to Silence and Interrupt effects.

806290.name: Aeon of Renewal
806290.desc: Reduces Epoch's healing by -30%, but causes it to heal for an additional 50% of the amount healed over 3 seconds.

806292.name: Aeon of Protection
806292.desc: Increases Epoch's cast time by 15%, healing done by 15%, and causes it to apply a damage absorption shield equal to 30% of the amount healed for 8 seconds.

806293.name: Aeon of Oblivion
806293.desc: Increases Epoch's mana cost by 30%, critical strike chance by 10%, and healing done by 15%. In addition, healing with Epoch now increases the target's damage dealt by 3% for 15 seconds.

806296.name: Ripple
806296.desc: Channel for up to 5 seconds. When the channel ends, if you channeled for at least 1.5 sec, allies within 40 yds are healed based on the duration of the channel. While channeling, you are immune to stun effects.

806299.name: Fabric of Time
806299.desc: Alter the fabric of time, healing an ally for 106 + 64% healing. Your next Aeon used within 8 seconds will trigger with no cooldown or cost.

806301.name: Eternity Warper
806301.desc: Level 50 Passive Your Ripple channel performs a unique effect based on your active Aeon:

806302.name: Shimmering Shard
806302.desc: Activating Aeon spells now grants you 4% increased damage and healing for 20 seconds, stacking 3 times.

806312.name: Infinite Keeper
806312.desc: Using Unmake on an enemy affected by your Timerend now causes the enemy to erupt in a vortex of sand, dealing 81 Chromatic Damage every 1 sec to up to 8 enemies for 6 seconds in an 8 yd radius.

806314.name: Keeper of Balance Trigger
806314.desc: Heals an ally for 0% Maximum Health plus 1. Can only be used while your Order and Chaos stacks are equal. Cannot critically strike.

806315.name: Temporal Anomaly
806315.desc: Augment reality for 10 seconds, causing 50% of the damage taken to be absorbed and converted into healing at the end of the duration.

806316.name: Maw of Chaos
806316.desc: Instantly Heals an ally for 244 to 248, increasing their Spell Haste by 15% for 6 sec. Grants 1 Chromatic.

806317.name: Shifting Sands
806317.desc: Blast an enemy for 726 Divine Damage, reducing their attack power by 30 for 8 sec, and granting Sands of Time. This spell belongs to Order. Entering Chaos Empowerment transforms this ability into Melt Reality . @ext::ext@

806326.name: Chronurgy
806326.desc: Instantly unleash a burst of magic dealing 315 Arcane Damage to an enemy and spreads active Decomposition to nearby targets. This spell belongs to both Chaos and Order and scales with modifiers to Discordance.

806333.name: Shield of Order
806333.desc: Heals the ally for 580% maximum health and grants a shield for 6 sec that absorbs 580 damage scaling with Spirit.

806335.name: Melt Reality
806335.desc: Melt the target's reality, dealing cond(gt(SPFR, SPS), 19+6+SPFR*0.23, 19+6+SPS*0.23) Chromatic Damage every 3 sec for 30 seconds. While active, periodic damage dealt to the target is replicated for 20% of the value to all enemies near them.

806338.name: Endless Sands
806338.desc: Casting Epoch now grants you Endless Sands.

806727.name: Displacement
806727.desc: Displaces a party or raid member and pulls them to you, dispelling root and snare effects from them.

806753.name: Timemage
806753.desc: Reduces the duration of harmful magic effects on you by -30%.

806755.name: Relocator Disc
806755.desc: Critically striking with Disc of Legends increases your movement speed by 100% for 1 sec.

807309.name: Bronze Timeways
807309.desc: Casting Correct the Mistake now grants 2 stacks of Endless Sands.

807569.name: Pure Chaos
807569.desc: While Incarnation of Chaos is active, all damage dealt now has a 5% chance to lock yourself in a time loop for 3 seconds, making you unable to cast any spells other than Chromatic Shard. While active, you cast Chromatic Shard free of cost, repeating every 1 sec.

807578.name: Chaos Fusion
807578.desc: While Incarnation of Chaos is active, you may now cast Chromatic Shard while moving, but the duration of Incarnation of Chaos is reduced by -3 sec.

807588.name: Temporal Convergence
807588.desc: Your Wand of Time now has a 40% chance to reset its own cooldown.

807589.name: Intuition
807589.desc: Level 50 Passive Increases your critical damage by 25%.

807691.name: Nozdormu's Gaze
807691.desc: Your Time Out! now regenerates -2% less mana per tick, but casting it now instantly restores 15% of your maximum mana.

807754.name: Timelost Power
807754.desc: Your Discordance now strikes 3 additional enemies.

887010.name: CoA Aura - Chronomancer Class
887010.desc: Tuning aura for Chronomancer Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887053.name: CoA Aura - Chronomancer - Infinite
887053.desc: Tuning aura for Chronomancer - Infinite. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887054.name: CoA Aura - Chronomancer - Time
887054.desc: Tuning aura for Chronomancer - Time. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887055.name: CoA Aura - Chronomancer - Artificer
887055.desc: Tuning aura for Chronomancer - Artificer. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.
